label: The Writer
tagline: A page that returns to the same sentence from a different angle.
cluster_explainer: The Writer brokers drafts to a small readership, not books to a wide one — they read the engine as a way to feel whether a paragraph has a cadence before they share it.
demo_highlights: Sphere is the geometry of an unfinished sentence — no edges to lock the meaning, every return starts a different arc
Mid-band reactance tracks the vocal cadence where a paragraph's rhythm lives, not the kick or the cymbal wash
Cassette preset evokes the lo-fi intimacy of a draft — the artifact that has not yet earned hi-fi
Smooth envelope (0.7) lets the engine follow a sentence's breath-in and breath-out rather than snapping to hits
No 'send to readers' button, no engagement telemetry in the demo: the writer is the only audience while the work is mid-stream
